title: rollout-start
description: Starts a staged rollout of one release (docs/spec/07-upgrade-channel.md "Staged rollout"): batch 1 is the one cabinet named here, batch 2 the in-office cabinets, batch 3 about 5 percent of the rest of the fleet, batch 4 everyone else. A batch must reach successRatePercent before the next starts; failures above failureLimitPercent of a batch pause the rollout on their own.

stepUpToken.description: A one-time step-up token bound to this exact action.
